thread:
ryan_sales: Heads-up: ZephyrWorks CTO just escalated. Private POC in ap-southeast shows sudden p95 latency spikes on multi-turn chat. They want an exec check-in if not resolved in 4h. @maya_se can you share quick repro? :exclamation:
maya_se: POC set up in their VPC using our private bundle (ap-southeast, 2x A100). Pattern: 45min steady, then p95 jumps from ~160ms -> 550ms and throughput drops ~18%. We see repeated kv-cache misses and occasional CUDA kernel retries. Short logs below.
maya_se: logs:
```
2026-03-22T03:14:02Z runtime: kvcache miss key=0x3a2b... miss_count=9
2026-03-22T03:14:04Z runtime: inference kernel retry code=14
2026-03-22T03:14:06Z network: tls renegotiate to kms-host=zeph-kms.local
```
jamal_runtime: Kernel retry + kvcache misses point to either memory pressure or intermittent NVLink hiccups. Also the TLS renegotiate to customer KMS could stall tokenization. I'll inspect host driver and nvlink counters.
sophie_infra: Which image and network config? If MTU/jumbo frames mismatch with Zephyr's edge appliance we can see packet drops. Also confirm host kernel and drivers align with our validated list.
maya_se: Image = rwi-private-2026-02-20. Zephyr uses an inline TLS terminator for their private KMS. They insist keys never leave their VPC.
leah_ciso: Zephyr legal/security asked for a diagram of where keys are decrypted and assurance we don't persist plaintext outside HSM. I'll draft the diagram once I have the exact call path. Also they want access logs for KMS operations for 60 days minimum.
ella_support: For a fast repro, we can failover traffic to Hosted ap-southeast to see baseline. If hosted remains stable that points to network or host image. We can also temporarily reduce cache TTL to avoid thrashing.
jamal_runtime: Mitigation plan: (1) run host-driver sanity check and patch if mismatch, (2) toggle cache TTL and close eviction window, (3) spin hosted parity cluster for a controlled run. I can push a driver patch build in ~90m and smoke test.
sophie_infra: Opening infra ticket INF-9402 and warming hosted nodes now. Also notifying oncall infra.
deploy-bot: Deployment triggered by jamal_runtime: driver-11.9.0-patch -> staging -> smoke. Status: queued.
ryan_sales: Zephyr wants to keep the private test but will allow a short hosted parity run if we can guarantee no key material leaves their VPC. They'll sign a temporary acceptance for hosted-run if we provide audit logs.
leah_ciso: We can provide aggregated audit logs and an ATO note for the hosted run. Need ops to confirm log retention window and PII redaction.
jamal_runtime: Smoke results: hosted baseline p95=150ms rps=210, private pre-patch p95=540ms rps=170, private post-patch p95=165ms rps=205. Patch appears to restore parity.
elly_sales: perfect, scheduling exec sync at 20:30 SGT to confirm numbers and next steps for reserved capacity pricing and compliance docs. Please keep updates short here only. :white_check_mark:
